name: Gritz N Wafflez
facts: Gritz N Wafflez is a woman-owned Texas Flava, Southern comfort restaurant in Koreatown, Los Angeles.
Address: 3183 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 185, Los Angeles, CA 90010.
Open daily 9 AM to 3 PM.
The first 15 minutes of valet are complimentary.
GNW Karaoke is every Wednesday, 6 to 10 PM.
Order Up! is a free game. You can play as often as you like with no account.
You need a free member account only to save a score or claim a prize.
Each Order Up! level lasts 90 seconds, and 3 walk-outs close the kitchen.
Adult mode prize scores: 13,500, 22,000, 32,000 and 46,500.
Kid mode prize scores: 9,500, 11,000, 12,750 and 13,250.

Game prizes must be used within 3 days, and you can hold one prize at a time.
The Daily Spin is free, one spin per member per day, and every slice wins.

Kid mode needs a parent or guardian to sign in first.
One free member account per person and per phone.

Prices are on the online order page, not in the app.

It's our free game where you work the line at Gritz N Wafflez. Build plates, serve them hot and deliver them to the right table.

qa.q: How do I play Order Up!?
qa.a: Tap food tiles to build the plate, tap Serve, then tap the hot plate on the pass and tap the guest's table to deliver it. Be fast, because food cools.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Order Up! is free to play as often as you like with no account. You need a free member account only to save a score or claim a prize.

qa.q: Do I have to buy anything to play or win?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to play, spin or win a prize, and a purchase doesn't improve your chances.
As often as you like. The game is free.
90 seconds. Pass a level by keeping fewer than 3 tables from walking out.
Levels 1 to 3: just tap and serve. Level 4: a cook leaves, so you're on the fryer. Level 5: the whole kitchen, including waffle irons and the skillet.

qa.q: How do I cook in the fryer?
qa.a: At level 4, tap the catfish, wingz, tenderz or shrimp tile, then tap the basket when it shows perfect. It lands on your plate.

qa.q: How do the waffle irons and skillet work?
qa.a: At level 5, pour the waffle and open the iron when it turns green. The skillet cooks eggs, bacon and sautéed shrimp.
At level 5, tickets can ask for things like sautéed shrimp, sunny-side eggs, extra-crispy bacon or syrup on the side. Tap the matching tile. Extra hot orders must arrive hot.

qa.q: Why does cold food pay less?
qa.a: Plates cool on the pass: hot, warm, cooling, then cold. Cold food pays less and gets no tip, so deliver fast.
Speed is the biggest part, then heat, the order's pay, tips, +30 for each correct item and +40 for a clean build with no undo. Perfect plates in a row build a streak up to ×2.
Speed points are counted to 0.1 second from the moment a table sits down and drop every tenth of a second, up to +190 per plate.
Perfect, fast plates in a row raise your multiplier ×1.2, ×1.4 and so on, up to ×2.

qa.q: What is the whole table bonus?
qa.a: Serve every plate at a table within 10 seconds of each other for +30 per guest.

qa.q: What is the level cleared bonus?
qa.a: You get 150 × your level, plus 75 for every walk-out you avoided.
Wrong plate −20, adding a NO item −60, wrong table −15 (the plate also comes back colder), undercooked −30, charred −15 and a walk-out −50.
A table that waited too long and left. Three walk-outs and the kitchen closes.

qa.q: What is the Antidote poster in the game?
qa.a: It's Antidote's food review poster on the top-left wall. Tap it for +250 points the first time each run, and you can watch his review.

qa.q: What can I win in the game?
qa.a: Adult mode: Free Kiki Palmer at 13,500; Free side of Smackin' Mac at 22,000; Free Fried Cheese Gritz at 32,000; Free Original Collard Green Dip at 46,500. Kid mode has kid-sized prizes. Each prize is for one run over that score.

qa.q: What are the Adult mode prize scores?
qa.a: 13,500 = Free Kiki Palmer. 22,000 = Free side of Smackin' Mac (with any order). 32,000 = Free Fried Cheese Gritz (with any plate). 46,500 = Free Original Collard Green Dip.

qa.q: What are the Kid mode prizes?
qa.a: 9,500 = Free Fresh Squeezed OJ. 11,000 = Free side of French Friez. 12,750 = Free Sweet Gritz. 13,250 = Free Chocolate Chip Waffle.
The prizes shown are samples, and Jurni picks the real ones. Check the Prizes screen in the game for what's current.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: Sign in with a free member account after your run to claim it. Show the code on your phone, with a matching account, at the counter.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a game prize?
qa.a: 3 days. You can hold one prize at a time.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins the weekly prize. Adult and Kid modes each have their own board, and the board resets every Monday.

qa.q: What does the weekly champion win?
qa.a: A Free Wingz N' Wafflez plus a karaoke shoutout. The winner is crowned at GNW Karaoke on Wednesday.

qa.q: When is the weekly winner picked?
qa.a: The top score at Sunday close wins, and the winner is crowned at GNW Karaoke on Wednesday.
The score that was posted first wins.

qa.q: Is the game skill or luck?
qa.a: It's a game of skill. Your score depends only on how well you run the line, and no game prize is awarded by chance.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.
A gentler version for ages 12 and under, with slower timers, kid-sized prizes and its own best score and weekly board.
A parent or guardian signs in first on the phone, then hands it over. Kid scores and prizes go on the parent's account, and the child never enters any info.

qa.q: How do I leave Kid mode?
qa.a: The app asks for the last 4 digits of the parent's phone number.
Kid prizes are redeemed with the young player at the table, one per kid per visit. Codes start with KID-.
No data is collected from children. The account belongs to the parent, and an optional nickname stays only on that phone.

qa.q: Can I win the bigger prizes in Kid mode?
qa.a: No. The bigger prizes (Smackin' Mac, Fried Cheese Gritz and Collard Green Dip) are Adult mode only.
A free wheel you can spin once a day as a member. Every slice wins something.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50 points, +100 points, +75 points, $2 off any plate, Free Kiki Palmer, Free side of Smackin' Mac or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $2 off a plate 15%, Free Kiki Palmer 8%, Free Smackin' Mac 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How many spins do I get?
qa.a: One free spin per member per day, on Los Angeles time. Spins are never sold.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Koreatown location, one reward per visit. They can't be combined with other rewards and have no cash value.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Sign up for a free member account with your name, phone number and email. The live app confirms your phone with a text code.
Yes, member accounts are free. It's one per person and one per phone.

qa.q: What do I get when I join?
qa.a: The welcome offer is a free Kiki Palmer with your next N' Wafflez plate.

qa.q: How do I redeem my points?

qa.q: Do points expire or have cash value?

qa.a: When you're near the restaurant, the app may show an offer: show it to your server for double points on today's order.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Use the globe button for English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย and Русский.

qa.q: How do I install the app on my phone?
qa.a: Use Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the browser menu, then Add to Home screen or Install.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Pair a controller, press any button, and use the D-pad and A to tap food, plates and tables.

qa.q: Can I get my score saved?
qa.a: Yes. After a run, sign up for a free member account to save your score and claim any prize.
Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Texts and emails are opt-in, and you can reply STOP anytime.
